Hi! intervals_overlap uses strict inequality: a[0] < b[1] and b[0] < a[1]. So touching intervals (e.g., [14,600) and [600,630)) do NOT overlap. Zero-length intervals (a[0]==a[1]) also never overlap. If your blackout is [600,630) and the occurrence is [14,600), they should NOT be flagged as overlapping. Check if your blackout boundaries are inclusive vs exclusive — that's likely the source of the extra (14,600,630) in your result.
